title: Ali's Sports Week
text:
My name is Ali. I like sports very much. On Monday, I play football with my friends. We play in the park after school. I am a good goalkeeper.

On Saturday, I swim in the pool with my sister. She likes swimming too. We swim for one hour. After that, we eat ice cream. I love weekends!

questions.text: What sport does Ali play on Monday?
Who does Ali swim with on Saturday?
How does Ali feel about sports?
What can we guess about Ali's weekends?
options: He stays at school on weekends

vocabulary.definition: a player who stops the ball from going into the goal
a large outdoor area with grass and trees where people play
a place with water where people swim
to move through water using your arms and legs

paragraph_translations: Benim adım Ali. Sporu çok severim. Pazartesi günü arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Okuldan sonra parkta oynarız. Ben iyi bir kaleciyim.
Cumartesi günü kız kardeşimle havuzda yüzerim. O da yüzmeyi sever. Bir saat yüzeriz. Sonra dondurma yeriz. Hafta sonlarını çok seviyorum!
